ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels (approx. 90-95%) with localized high-intensity white pixel clusters (approx. 5-10%) creating a high-contrast speckled distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Widespread distribution of small (3-12 pixel diameter) high-contrast circular white blobs across the entire visible ventral surface; larger irregular high-intensity white clusters are localized at the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression with a pixel angle of approximately 105 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 50 pixels relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous trailing boundary with low-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (1-4 pixel height); visible indentation on the right lobe approximately two-thirds of the distance from the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a consistent concave sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips; outer leading edges are partially occluded but show convex curvature toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely populated spatial clusters of roughly circular high-contrast white pixel groups (5-15 pixel diameter) across both lobes, most concentrated in the medial regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned diagonal and vertical high-contrast linear streaks (15-50 pixels in length) visible on the left lobe and inner right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular high-intensity textured pixel clusters at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with localized physical accretion or trauma.
